you_should_know.title: What Canada's retaliatory tariffs could mean for Minnesotans
you_should_know.description: Canada's finance minister on Tuesday says a set of retaliatory tariffs​ will target more than $27 billion of U.S. imports, including steel, appliances and dairy.

you_should_know.title: Walz executive order to restrict mining near Boundary Waters faces bipartisan backlash in northern Minnesota
you_should_know.summary: Several Democratic candidates running in northern Minnesota legislative races in November have publicly broken with Gov. Walz over his executive order on mining near the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness, lake country on the Canadian border roughly 250 miles north of Minneapolis.

you_should_know.title: County attorney declines felony charges against Jake Lang, city could still pursue charges
you_should_know.description: The Hennepin County Attorney's Office said a review of evidence showed there was "not a path forward" for felony charges.
